query: EGFR C797S
notes: PAPER:LUNG_EGFR_P01 is wholly about C797S: it phases the substitution cis/trans against T790M in 44 carriers and shows the cis triple mutant is refractory to every approved agent. GRANT:LUNG_EGFR_G01 is the grant devoted to on-target C797S escape. P10 and G05 judged 0: exon 20 insertion work that mentions T790M and wild-type sparing but never the tertiary cysteine substitution.

PAPER:LUNG_EGFR_P03 reports the phase 2 study registered as NCT03778229 (savolitinib plus osimertinib after high-level MET copy gain) and prints the identifier verbatim; GRANT:LUNG_EGFR_G02 is the funding grant carrying the same identifier. P04 is a sibling publication of that grant on MET assay concordance (marginal). P02/P17 report other osimertinib-progression cohorts under different identifiers.

PAPER:HEME_CART_P08 is the prophylactic anakinra phase 2 study carrying NCT04150913; GRANT:HEME_CART_G04 proposes exactly that trial and prints the identifier. P07 is the mechanistic IL-1beta and angiopoietin paper from the same grant. P16 and P21 are registry and cytopenia studies with no trial identifier.

PAPER:HEME_CART_P02 is the bivalent CD19/CD22 phase 1 dose-escalation carrying NCT03919240; GRANT:HEME_CART_G01 proposes translating that bivalent receptor into the same registered study. P01 is the escape-mechanism paper from the same grant. P09 and P20 are other cell products.

PAPER:IMMUNO_CHECKPOINT_P12 reports the two-cycle preoperative nivolumab plus low-dose ipilimumab study registered as NCT04205552; GRANT:IMMUNO_CHECKPOINT_G06 is the preoperative program carrying it. P13 is the companion preoperative lung trial from the same grant, under a different identifier.

PAPER:IMMUNO_CHECKPOINT_P01 (JAK1/JAK2 loss at progression on pembrolizumab) carries NCT03521739, and GRANT:IMMUNO_CHECKPOINT_G01 carries the same identifier for its paired-biopsy cohort. P02 and P03 are other publications of that grant. P15 is HLA LOH work from a different grant.

PAPER:LUNG_EGFR_P09 is the amivantamab exon 20 insertion study carrying NCT04988295; GRANT:LUNG_EGFR_G05 is the structure-guided exon 20 program carrying it. P10 (insertion-selective inhibitor) and P23 (amivantamab supportive care) are marginally related. P11 is an ALK trial.

query: 22C3 clone
notes: PAPER:IMMUNO_CHECKPOINT_P18 is the head-to-head analytical comparison of the 22C3, 28-8, SP263 and SP142 assays on serial sections, i.e. the document the string is about. G04 will stain all 1400 blocks with the 22C3 and SP263 clones; P08 centrally generated PD-L1 immunohistochemistry with the 22C3 clone. P03, P02 and P13 each mention the clone once in Methods. P19 judged 0 as a tempting near-miss: assay-variance methodology, but for mutational burden, with no antibody clone involved.

query: SP142
notes: PAPER:IMMUNO_CHECKPOINT_P18 is the only document that uses SP142; it shows the clone stains tumor cells less intensely and shifts tumor proportion score down 14 percentage points, which is the substantive claim about the string. G04 (central PD-L1 clone comparison program) and P08 (central PD-L1 staining) are marginal: the same assay-selection problem, but with other clones. P19 and P13 judged 0.

query: TNO155
notes: PAPER:LUNG_EGFR_P15 is the only document naming TNO155 and is about adding that SHP2 inhibitor to adagrasib to abolish adaptive receptor rebound. GRANT:LUNG_EGFR_G08 is the funding grant that proposes suppressing exactly this rebound; it names SHP2 but not the compound code. P03 and G02 judged 0: also combination receptor blockade, but MET plus EGFR rather than the phosphatase.

query: WLT-233
notes: PAPER:LUNG_EGFR_P19 is the only document naming WLT-233 and characterises it as the cereblon-recruiting bifunctional molecule that clears EGFR triple mutants (94 percent protein loss, DC50 14 nM). GRANT:LUNG_EGFR_G12 funds it and describes the same preliminary compound without the code name. GRANT:BREAST_CDK_G12 and PAPER:BREAST_CDK_P17 judged 0 as deliberate cross-subdomain near-misses: cereblon-recruiting degraders, but of the estrogen receptor.

query: DFC-114
notes: PAPER:LUNG_EGFR_P01 is the only document naming DFC-114 and reports its IC50 of 18 nM against the cis triple mutant with 61-fold wild-type sparing. GRANT:LUNG_EGFR_G01 funds the allosteric-inhibitor program and names EAI045 instead. PAPER:LUNG_EGFR_P10 judged 0: a different structure-guided compound (SRX-2109) against a different allele class.

PAPER:LUNG_EGFR_P10 is the only document naming SRX-2109 and reports its crystal-structure-guided design, cellular IC50 of 12 to 41 nM, and unbound brain-to-plasma ratio of 0.51. GRANT:LUNG_EGFR_G05 funds that chemistry. PAPER:LUNG_EGFR_P01 judged 0: a different compound code against a different allele.

query: G1202R plus L1198F compound mutation
notes: PAPER:LUNG_EGFR_P12 phases 34 compound alleles and names G1202R plus L1198F and G1202R plus L1196M as the commonest pairs, showing no approved inhibitor reaches an achievable IC50 against them; GRANT:LUNG_EGFR_G07 is built on that exact problem. P19 and G12 propose targeted degradation as the answer to those same compound alleles. P16 judged 0: lorlatinib appears there only as a brain-partitioning measurement.

query: CCNE1 amplification
notes: GRANT:BREAST_CDK_G03 and PAPER:BREAST_CDK_P05 are the two documents whose whole subject is cyclin E1-CDK2 as the CCNE1-amplified route around CDK4/6 blockade; P05 shows enforced cyclin E1 shifts the palbociclib IC50 12- to 18-fold and that CDK2 inhibition reverses it. P03, P04, G01 and P16 report CCNE1 gain as a resistance finding. PAPER:LUNG_EGFR_P02 and P13 are cross-subdomain passing mentions ("cell cycle gene alterations, chiefly CCNE1 amplification and CDKN2A loss") and are graded 1. P07 judged 0: RB and senescence biology with no CCNE1 involvement.

query: ESR1 Y537S
notes: GRANT:BREAST_CDK_G02 compares the pharmacology of Y537S, D538G, E380Q and L536P receptors head to head; PAPER:BREAST_CDK_P06 shows Y537S allele fractions rise steadily and dominate at progression in 61 percent of carriers while D538G falls in 44 percent; PAPER:BREAST_CDK_P02 assays Y537S directly by droplet digital PCR. PAPER:BREAST_CDK_P23 judged 0 as the sharpest near-miss in the corpus: it studies germline ESR1 variants (rs2234693, rs9340799) and explicitly finds no association, which is a different entity from the acquired ligand-binding domain substitution.

query: TNFRSF17
notes: PAPER:HEME_CART_P05 defines biallelic TNFRSF17 loss (7 homozygous deletions and 4 deletion-plus-truncating combinations, all with absent surface staining) as one of two routes to teclistamab failure; GRANT:HEME_CART_G03 names biallelic deletion or truncating mutation of TNFRSF17 as its first resistance class. P06 measures the same target loss before switching agents. P23 graded 1: belantamab mafodotin is directed at the same receptor but the paper never uses the gene symbol. P01 judged 0: antigen escape, but CD19 in leukemia.

query: GPRC5D
notes: PAPER:HEME_CART_P06 is the talquetamab (GPRC5D-directed) cohort after BCMA failure and reports the target-specific dysgeusia and nail toxicity; GRANT:HEME_CART_G03 proposes exactly the switch to the GPRC5D-directed agent when the first target is lost. P05 profiles the same sequencing problem from the BCMA side. P23 judged 0: an antibody-drug conjugate against the other target.

query: HLA-E single-chain trimer
notes: PAPER:HEME_CART_P10 inserts an HLA-E single-chain trimer bearing a VMAPRTLVL peptide into the disrupted B2M locus and shows it cuts median NK-mediated lysis from 48 to 11 percent; GRANT:HEME_CART_G05 proposes that exact knock-in. PAPER:IMMUNO_CHECKPOINT_P15 and GRANT:IMMUNO_CHECKPOINT_G08 judged 0 as cross-subdomain near-misses: HLA loss of heterozygosity in tumors, an unrelated use of the same gene family and of the word HLA.

query: TREM2
notes: GRANT:IMMUNO_CHECKPOINT_G02 is built entirely on the TREM2 macrophage program; PAPER:IMMUNO_CHECKPOINT_P04 raises a depleting anti-TREM2 antibody and shows Fc-dependent removal restores anti-PD-1 sensitivity; P05 identifies the TREM2-high state by single-cell and spatial profiling. P22 applies it outside checkpoint therapy. P03 and P17 are single passing mentions. PAPER:LUNG_EGFR_P18 judged 0 as a cross-subdomain near-miss: suppressive macrophages, but scored by CD163 and TGFB1 and never by TREM2.

query: NT5E CD73
notes: PAPER:IMMUNO_CHECKPOINT_P16 shows NT5E-positive stroma and CD11b cells generate the adenosine that silences CD8 cells in poorly perfused regions, and that conditional Nt5e deletion in phagocytes drops intratumoral adenosine by 61 percent; GRANT:IMMUNO_CHECKPOINT_G09 proposes that ectoenzyme axis. P03 and P07 each mention NT5E expression once. PAPER:HEME_CART_P14 judged 0: hypoxia-responsive engineering with no adenosine axis.

query: ABCB1 ABCG2 efflux transporter
notes: PAPER:LUNG_EGFR_P16 measures unbound partitioning in Abcb1 and Abcg2 knockout animals and attributes most of the variance to efflux; GRANT:LUNG_EGFR_G09 proposes exactly that; PAPER:BREAST_CDK_P15 shows Abcb1/Abcg2 knockout raises palbociclib brain exposure 11-fold but abemaciclib exposure only 1.4-fold. A genuinely cross-subdomain string. PAPER:BREAST_CDK_P18 graded 1 (ABCB1 rs1045642 genotype, null result). PAPER:BREAST_CDK_P13 judged 0: a different transporter (ABCC2 and the lysosomal SLC46A3).

query: why does a bit of the mass stay put and not die when the pill is on board
notes: PAPER:LUNG_EGFR_P05 is the drug-tolerant persister paper: cells that neither proliferate nor die while drug is present, acquire no new kinase-domain variants, and depend on GPX4. GRANT:LUNG_EGFR_G06 is the program on that same reservoir. The query shares no content word of length 5 or more with either. PAPER:BREAST_CDK_P07 is a cross-subdomain 1: the same arrested-but-not-killed idea in breast senescence. P13 judged 0 because it catalogues genomic escape events, the opposite of a non-genetic persister state.

query: which gene faults at the outset warn that a lung mass will later turn into a whole other kind
notes: PAPER:LUNG_EGFR_P07 is precisely this question: baseline biallelic RB1 and TP53 inactivation carries a relative risk of 27 for conversion to a neuroendocrine phenotype within 3 years. GRANT:LUNG_EGFR_G04 is the lineage-plasticity grant behind it. P08 supplies the mouse model and enhancer mechanism; P06 finds the ASCL1/INSM1/DLL3 state already present at maximal response. P12 judged 0: compound kinase mutations, a genotypic rather than a phenotypic switch.

query: how much of each pill actually gets past the vessel wall and into the head
notes: PAPER:LUNG_EGFR_P16 measures unbound partitioning across the neurovascular barrier for nine agents and shows total-drug ratios misrank five of them; GRANT:LUNG_EGFR_G09 proposes the same measurement program. Judged across two subdomain files: PAPER:BREAST_CDK_P15 and GRANT:BREAST_CDK_G10 ask the identical question for CDK4/6 inhibitors. PAPER:LUNG_EGFR_P22 judged 0 because it reports central nervous system disease-free survival and never a drug concentration.

query: who never gets their DNA read and never gets the right pill for their lung growth
notes: PAPER:LUNG_EGFR_P20 measures both failure steps in 11,438 patients: 62 percent complete broad profiling, and each extra week of turnaround cuts the odds of starting matched therapy by 9 percent. GRANT:LUNG_EGFR_G11 proposes exactly that two-step measurement. PAPER:HEME_CART_P17 and PAPER:BREAST_CDK_P21 are cross-subdomain 1s (referral and affordability funnels). PAPER:IMMUNO_CHECKPOINT_P21 judged 0: a payer cost-effectiveness model, not an access gap.

query: what is left behind at the very deepest reply to the pill
notes: PAPER:LUNG_EGFR_P06 profiles 214,000 cells from specimens taken at maximal response, literally the residual population at the deepest point of response, and finds three recurrent transcriptional states plus coordinated antigen-presentation suppression. G06 and P05 study the same reservoir functionally. P22 graded 1 for postoperative molecular residual disease. P13 judged 0: its sampling is at progression, not at response.

query: how many ways at once does a growth find to get around the sticky drug
notes: PAPER:LUNG_EGFR_P14 is about exactly this multiplicity: a median of two independent alterations per patient, 27 percent with three or more, after covalent (irreversibly binding, hence "sticky") KRAS G12C inhibition, with shorter survival when more alterations coexist. GRANT:LUNG_EGFR_G08 frames the same fragmented-escape problem. P02 and P13 report coexisting alterations for a different covalent agent. P16 and P11 judged 0.

query: can a later drug mop up the sleepy left over bits so the lump stays away
notes: PAPER:BREAST_CDK_P07 shows 58 to 74 percent of arrested cells acquire senescence markers, identifies BCL2L1 as their survival dependency by CRISPR screen, and shows a BCL-xL-selective agent removes 82 percent of them and doubles time to regrowth: the "second drug that mops up" question. GRANT:BREAST_CDK_G06 proposes pharmacologic clearance of those cells. PAPER:BREAST_CDK_P05 judged 0 as a near-miss: also a follow-on agent after CDK4/6 failure, but a CDK2 inhibitor aimed at proliferating cells rather than at the arrested ones.

query: do two people who look at the same slide agree on how much faint dye they see
notes: PAPER:BREAST_CDK_P09 reports a Fleiss kappa of 0.61 among five pathologists for the 0 versus 1+ boundary and a continuous receptor distribution with no natural break there; PAPER:IMMUNO_CHECKPOINT_P18 reports intraclass correlation 0.83 for tumor-cell scoring falling to 0.19 for immune-cell scoring across 28 pathologists. Both are top-relevant and both satisfy the no-shared-word rule. This query is judged across all four subdomain files. PAPER:BREAST_CDK_P20 judged 0: radiologic phenotypes, not slide scoring.

query: why do some lumps stop caring about the armed drug after a while
notes: PAPER:BREAST_CDK_P13 is the acquired-resistance paper for an antibody carrying a cytotoxic payload: reduced surface target without gene loss in 6 of 9 patient pairs, plus loss of the lysosomal transporter that cuts intracellular payload accumulation by 71 percent. GRANT:BREAST_CDK_G04 funds the payload-delivery program. PAPER:LUNG_EGFR_P17 is a cross-subdomain 1 (same drug class, HER3 target). PAPER:BREAST_CDK_P20 judged 0: lung toxicity of the same agent, not loss of activity.

query: does more drug in the blood mean a bigger drop in white cell counts
notes: PAPER:BREAST_CDK_P18 builds a population pharmacokinetic model and reports an odds ratio of 2.91 for grade 3 or higher neutropenia in the highest exposure quartile versus the lowest: exactly the exposure-toxicity question. PAPER:IMMUNO_CHECKPOINT_P20 is the cross-subdomain counterpart (population pharmacokinetics with an exposure-response analysis that finds a flat relationship). P14, P23 and P21 judged 0: they report discontinuation and symptoms without any exposure measurement.

query: do money worries make people skip or put off their daily pill
notes: PAPER:BREAST_CDK_P21 links pharmacy refill records, prior-authorization logs and financial screening: out-of-pocket cost above 100 dollars a month carries an adjusted odds ratio of 2.41 for non-adherence, and 22 percent waited more than 30 days for a first dispense. GRANT:BREAST_CDK_G09 targets early discontinuation directly. PAPER:IMMUNO_CHECKPOINT_P21 judged 0: it models cost from a payer perspective and says nothing about whether patients take the drug.

query: what can you see in a lab draw ahead of the nerve upset
notes: PAPER:HEME_CART_P07 shows interleukin 1 beta rises a median of 22 hours before the first neurologic sign and that a pre-infusion angiopoietin ratio of 2.9 versus 1.1 separates patients who later develop severe neurotoxicity: a circulating signal that precedes the neurologic event. GRANT:HEME_CART_G04 proposes that pre-infusion risk score. PAPER:HEME_CART_P21 judged 0 because it explicitly shows inflammatory markers do not explain its endpoint, and that endpoint is marrow rather than neurologic.

query: which way of hunting for a trace of what is left over finds more of it
notes: PAPER:HEME_CART_P11 is the head-to-head: sequencing found disease in 68 specimens scored negative by flow while flow found 9 scored negative by sequencing, with latent-class sensitivity 0.93 versus 0.71. GRANT:HEME_CART_G06 proposes exactly that paired comparison across 900 specimens. Cross-subdomain 1s: PAPER:LUNG_EGFR_P22 and GRANT:BREAST_CDK_G07 pose the same detection-floor question for plasma-based residual disease.

query: how far do you have to drive to get the cell fix, and who never gets sent
notes: PAPER:HEME_CART_P17 reports referral probability falling 9 percent per 25 miles of driving distance, adjusted odds ratios of 0.62 for Medicaid enrollees and 0.71 for Black patients, and only 22 percent of label-eligible patients ultimately infused. GRANT:HEME_CART_G09 proposes that referral-funnel map. Cross-subdomain 1s in lung cover the analogous testing funnel. PAPER:HEME_CART_P18 judged 0: infection burden, not access.

query: why does the blood take so long to bounce back after the cell fix
notes: PAPER:HEME_CART_P21 sequences pre-infusion marrow in 388 adults and shows PPM1D and TP53 clonal hematopoiesis (adjusted odds ratios 2.7 and 3.1), rather than inflammatory intensity, explains neutrophil counts staying below 500 per microlitre beyond day 30. GRANT:HEME_CART_G12 poses that exact either/or (damaged marrow versus sustained inflammatory insult). PAPER:BREAST_CDK_P18 judged 0 as a cross-subdomain near-miss: also low neutrophils, but driven by drug exposure in an unrelated setting.

query: can the fix itself seed a brand new blood cancer down the line
notes: PAPER:HEME_CART_P22 traces vector integration sites in the 7 T-cell neoplasms arising after infusion among 1932 patients (4-year cumulative incidence 0.42 percent, with myeloid neoplasms more common at 3.1 percent). GRANT:HEME_CART_G12 proposes following that same cohort for second neoplasms with integration analysis on any T-lineage event. GRANT:HEME_CART_G05 graded 1 for its insertional-event risk aim. P20 and P16 judged 0.

query: if no trace is left after care, can that stand in for how long people stay free of growth
notes: PAPER:HEME_CART_P12 is the trial-level surrogacy meta-analysis: R-squared 0.72 between treatment effects on the odds of undetectable residual disease and treatment effects on progression-free survival across 14 randomized trials. GRANT:HEME_CART_G06 proposes evaluating whether a negative result behaves as a valid trial-level surrogate. Cross-subdomain 1s: PAPER:IMMUNO_CHECKPOINT_P13 and GRANT:IMMUNO_CHECKPOINT_G06 pose the same surrogate-endpoint question for pathologic response.

query: does the gut and skin upset come from the very same fighter cell that goes after the growth
notes: PAPER:IMMUNO_CHECKPOINT_P10 sequences paired tumor and affected-tissue biopsies and finds clones shared between the two in 41 percent of colitis and 22 percent of dermatitis cases, with sharers responding better: the direct test of whether toxicity and efficacy run through the same clones. GRANT:IMMUNO_CHECKPOINT_G05 proposes exactly that uncoupling question. PAPER:LUNG_EGFR_P23 judged 0 as a cross-subdomain near-miss: also rash management, but a non-immune on-target skin effect.

query: why does a fighter cell go quiet where a mass has a poor blood feed
notes: PAPER:IMMUNO_CHECKPOINT_P16 shows CD8 cells inside pimonidazole-labeled (poorly perfused) regions are present at equivalent density but carry 68 percent less granzyme B and 74 percent less TNF, and that A2A antagonism restores granule release. GRANT:IMMUNO_CHECKPOINT_G09 proposes that oxygen-deprivation mechanism. PAPER:HEME_CART_P14 is a cross-subdomain 1 (hypoxia-restricted payload to restore local function). GRANT:IMMUNO_CHECKPOINT_G07 judged 0: dysfunction framed as a differentiation state rather than regional metabolism.

query: do bugs in the gut, and pills that kill them, change who does well
notes: PAPER:IMMUNO_CHECKPOINT_P17 links systemic antibiotics within 30 days to shorter survival (hazard ratio 1.61) and lower response (22 versus 38 percent), and reproduces the phenotype by transferring communities into germ-free mice. GRANT:IMMUNO_CHECKPOINT_G11 treats the intestinal community as a modifiable exposure. PAPER:HEME_CART_P18 judged 0 as a cross-subdomain near-miss: antimicrobials and infections, but as a toxicity outcome rather than a modifier of therapy benefit.

query: how noisy is the count of DNA typos when you only read part of the code
notes: PAPER:IMMUNO_CHECKPOINT_P19 is precisely this: downsampling exomes to panel footprints gives a coefficient of variation above 30 percent below 0.8 megabases and categorical misclassification in 22 percent of specimens. P08 and P09 both cite it as the calibration reference for their burden estimates, which is how they entered this pool. PAPER:LUNG_EGFR_P04 is a cross-subdomain 1 (assay-to-assay disagreement in copy-number calling). PAPER:HEME_CART_P19 judged 0: analytical validation, but of a cytometry assay with no sequencing footprint issue.

query: why do some lung growths never react at all to the immune drug
notes: PAPER:IMMUNO_CHECKPOINT_P02 defines a subset with biallelic B2M inactivation, clonal in 30 of 38 cases before treatment, whose objective response rate is 2.6 versus 31.8 percent despite equivalent PD-L1 scores and mutation counts, i.e. never-responders rather than escapers. PAPER:LUNG_EGFR_P18 is a cross-subdomain 2 (spatial basis of checkpoint failure in EGFR-mutant lung tumors). PAPER:IMMUNO_CHECKPOINT_P01 judged 0 deliberately: it is the mirror image, loss of benefit after a confirmed response rather than primary failure.
